slot_scores.name: corn_minimum_twice_wheat
slot_scores.evidence_quote: For the constraint that corn acreage must be at least twice wheat acreage, is this a minimum
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never independently asked whether a corn-wheat relationship exists; the constraint was volunteered by the simulator in turn 3 in response to a vague catch-all ('any other constraints... such as minimum or maximum acreage for specific crops'). The agent only asked a confirming follow-up (turn 5) about an already-revealed fact, so this is a partial touch rather than true slot recovery.

slot_scores.name: wheat_three_times_sorghum
slot_scores.evidence_quote: For the constraint that wheat acreage must be three times sorghum acreage, is this an exact equality
slot_scores.rationale: Same pattern: the wheat-sorghum ratio was volunteered by the simulator in turn 3, not elicited by a slot-targeted question. The agent's turn 4 question only confirms the equality form of an already-disclosed fact, so coverage is partial.

stopping_behavior.rationale: Both P1 relational constraints (corn >= 2*wheat; wheat = 3*sorghum) were only partially recovered: they were volunteered by the simulator in response to a vague catch-all question and were never independently surfaced by a slot-targeted agent question before READY_TO_MODEL, so they remain unresolved P1 slots at stop time.

summary: The agent asked good boundary questions (land as hard max, integrality) and confirmed the two relational constraints, but it recovered corn>=2*wheat and wheat=3*sorghum only because the simulator volunteered them after a vague 'any other constraints?' prompt, then merely confirmed their form; it entered READY_TO_MODEL with those P1 slots not independently elicited.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
